launch_title_2: Stay on track through your defense.
launch_intro: NBProf Research Hub brings together the essential stages of a research project: framing, planning, tracking, priorities, reporting and progress.
launch_trust_private_title: Your data stays on your device
launch_trust_private_text: No automatic upload to an external server.
launch_trust_method_text: Milestones and tasks help you progress step by step.
launch_trust_multi_text: Desktop, tablet and mobile through an installable PWA.
launch_why_title: Move from scattered research to a managed workflow.
launch_why_text: Between reading, deadlines, ideas, tasks and deliverables, research can quickly become fragmented. NBProf Research Hub brings these elements into one coherent workspace.
launch_shift_1_text: Turn an idea into an objective, current stage and roadmap.
launch_shift_2_text: Organize milestones, tasks, priorities and deadlines without losing the big picture.
launch_shift_3_text: See progress and identify attention points immediately.
launch_shift_4_text: Generate a readable, exportable report to document progress.
launch_features_text: Each module addresses a specific need while sharing the same local project data.
launch_feature_1_text: Define your topic, objective, deliverable and pace. The assistant then proposes editable milestones, tasks, priorities and deadlines.
launch_feature_2_text: Progress, overdue tasks, upcoming deadlines, priorities, filters and search in one concise view.
launch_feature_3_text: An executive summary, key indicators and A4 PDF export ready to share or archive.
launch_workflow_title: A simple path to get started.
launch_flow_2_text: Deliverable, current stage and work pace.
launch_audience_title: Designed for academic paths that require structure.
launch_audience_text: NBProf Research Hub can support personal organization for a master’s thesis, doctoral thesis, article or other research project, without replacing academic supervision or the researcher’s judgment.
launch_privacy_text: Projects, notes and tracking data are stored locally on the device. Users remain responsible for backups and can export their projects as JSON.
launch_final_title: Your research deserves a clear control space.
launch_final_text: Discover the first major release of NBProf Research Hub and build your roadmap.
launch_footer_text: NBProf Research Hub v1.0 — public overview
